extracted.name: Basic Focaccia Flatbread (from All-purpose Baking Mix)
extracted.description: 4 net carbs Recipe from Wheat Belly Cook Book **Follow the recipe for All-purpose Baking Mix that I have to make these. **I used this recipe for pizza. Will have to try Italian version next! VARIATIONS: Italian-style: add in 2 tsp ground Rosemary, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp garlic powder After baking: brush top with EVOO and sprinkle with grated Parmesan With cream cheese: add in 1 tsp cinnamon, 1/2 tsp nutmeg, sweetener equal to 1 tsp sugar
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line baking sheet with parchment paper.
In large bowl, place baking mix.
In small bowl, combine oil, vinegar, water and salt. Add to baking mix and quickly mix together. Let sit 1 min., then add eggs and mix thoroughly.
Place dough on baking sheet and form 8x12 inch rectangle.
Bake 15 min. or until lightly browned. Cut into into 6 pieces and store in refrigerator.
